name: Lumen
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at the diameter JPL lists; not three measured axes.
credit: JPL Small-Body Database, physical parameters for 141 Lumen: diameter 117.916 ± 1.361 km; JPL's stated reference: urn:nasa:pds:neowise_diameters_albedos::2.0[mainbelt] (http://adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...791..121M)
shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at the 117.916 km diameter the JPL Small-Body Database lists for Lumen. No shape model is published.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole, arbitrary prime meridian and phase; no spin pole is published.
surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed color or terrain.
introduction: Lumen was found at Paris on 13 January 1875.
datasetSummary: A sphere at the 117.916 km diameter JPL lists. Its shape and pole are not measured.
